Introduction

    This sample contains the introductory screens to a BBS door game
    I started back in 1996.  I've decided to continue development of
    the game using this terminal I/O library as well as other libraries
    on thoughtproject.com (e.g. the Telnet class library).
    
    This isn't much of a demo -- but it does give you an idea of the
    philosophy behind the terminal engine.  The code initializes the
    library and then displays a few files.
    
    The screens are copyrighted and distributed outside of the LGPL
    for now.  However, should the three or four people (worldwide) who
    are still interested in door development contact me, I'd be happy
    to jointly create a new game.  :-) I don't even remember the original
    game concept, if there even was one.
